headline: ChatGPT extension can now access your Chrome tabs
summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT extension for Chrome has been updated to allow the AI to view and interact with your open browser tabs, enhancing its capabilities for tasks like comparison and data retrieval.
details: OpenAI has rolled out an update to its ChatGPT Google Chrome extension, enabling it to access information from your currently open browser tabs. This new functionality allows ChatGPT to analyze and utilize the content of your tabs when you specifically tag Chrome within the ChatGPT web or desktop application.

A demonstration video showcased a user asking ChatGPT to compare sofa options by referencing three open tabs. This highlights the extension's ability to process and synthesize information directly from your browsing session.

The updated extension also brings the full power of ChatGPT to the sidebar, allowing users to interact with the AI without leaving their current webpage. This includes access to conversation history and the ability to perform tasks within Chat or Work modes.

Furthermore, the ChatGPT Work feature can now "control" Chrome tabs for actions such as sending messages, filling out forms, or downloading files. This functionality is similar to Google's Gemini-powered "auto browse" feature and can also assist in organizing or grouping open tabs.
